Welcome to WorkPulse. WorkPulse shows how your team spends its working time: attendance, applications, websites and productivity, all in one clear view.
It works in three parts. A small desktop agent runs on each employee's Windows computer. It sends activity to WorkPulse, and you see everything here, in your browser.
Monitoring is open and based on consent. When the agent is first set up, the employee reviews what may be recorded, and must accept every item. A tray icon shows that WorkPulse is running.
WorkPulse records times and counts, never content. It never records what is typed, passwords, or private browsing windows.
The sidebar is grouped into sections. Overview holds your Dashboard, the home page.
Workforce holds People, Live Tracking for screenshots and live view, Activity, and Time and Attendance.
Work holds Projects and Tasks, and Productivity. Operations holds Alerts and Reports.
Administration holds Settings, where you set up your workspace, monitoring and customer systems, and Security. Help, with these tutorials, is in your profile menu.
On the Dashboard, choose a date range to see attendance, productivity, and the most used websites and applications. Use the Customize button to add, hide or move cards.
To get started, add your employees, install the desktop agent, and set your work schedule. The next tutorials show each step.
